title: DealDesk — From enquiry to order (loud)
sr: DealDesk by agenthouse. Email, CRM, Word or Excel, PDF, email, re-entry. One enquiry, many handovers. It is the gaps between them. One process: enquiry, configuration, quote, customer decision, order, confirmation. One shared status. Acceptance becomes an order, without re-entering line items. From enquiry to order. agenthouse.org/en/dealdesk
